description: This file implements a network channel event sink for monitoring redirects in Mozilla Firefox. It defines a class that observes network channel redirections, manages registration with the component registrar, and provides singleton factory methods.

classes.name: ChannelEventSink
classes.description: Implements nsIChannelEventSink to monitor channel redirects and notify registered collectors.

methods.name: registerCollector
methods.description: Registers a collector object to be notified on channel redirects.

methods.name: unregisterCollector
methods.description: Unregisters a collector object and unregisters the factory if no collectors remain.

methods.name: asyncOnChannelRedirect
methods.description: Handles the channel redirect event, notifying all registered collectors.
